explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/150: c(n)^{1/n} → α for some α < 2, where c(n) is the maximum number of inclusion-minimal disconnecting vertex sets (IsMinimalCut) of an n-vertex graph. Upper bounds for minimal (a,b)-separators (FKTV08, FoVi12) transfer, because every inclusion-minimal cut is a minimal (a,b)-separator for some pair. Existence of the limit is due to Bradač, and a formal proof is linked.
